segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Hey, quick one on Northline. Did you see their note about moving go-live from April 8 to April 22?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yeah, I saw it. That should be fine. It doesn't change the term, right, still 12 months from signature?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Correct. Signature target is March 28, term starts April 22, 54 seats. They asked if we can keep the $38,400 net if they add the support package in Q3.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I wouldn't promise that. Say pricing is held for the initial 54 and any add-ons follow the then-current rate card unless it's in the order form.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Got it. Also, on the renewal doc, use 54 seats, $38,400 net, billing contact Dana Lee. I fixed the packet and invoice draft this morning, but the CRM still had 51, so deal desk bounced the approval.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay, yeah, update that and resubmit. If it comes back clean, I can review the redline before end of day.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Thanks. Their procurement person also asked for net 45. They're on net 30 today.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: We can do net 45 if they sign by Friday and remove the convenience termination language. Put that in the reply, short and friendly.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the revised proposal after your redline, probably around 4:30.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Perfect. And keep the go-live date in the email body so services can staff it without digging through the attachment.
